title: 🎨 Palette: [a11y] Semantic close button for config window
body:
💡 What: Converted the close button on the configuration window from a non-semantic anchor (`<a>`) to a native `<button>`, adding appropriate ARIA labels and focus-visible styling.

🎯 Why: To ensure screen readers announce the button correctly and to provide clear visual feedback for keyboard-only users when navigating the modal.

📸 Before/After: Before, it was an anchor tag lacking keyboard focus styles. After, it provides a clear outline on keyboard focus and semantic meaning.

♿ Accessibility: Native button handles Space/Enter automatically. Added `aria-label` for screen reader context and hidden the inner decorative icon to reduce noise.
